title: DevForgeAI System Architecture Output Contract
description: Ratified JSON Schema (v1.0) for the System Architecture Document produced by the spec-driven-system-architecture skill - the macro / constitutional architect phase of the modernized DevForgeAI pipeline. Ratified by ADR-067; originated as a deliverable of the architecture-phase modernization gap analysis (ARCH-GAPS-001, Gap D - no published architecture-output contract). The skill consumes the PM plan (ideation-output.schema.json v1.0) and emits this contract; the downstream spec-driven-solution-architecture skill consumes it. additionalProperties is true at object level for forward-compatibility, matching ideation-output.schema.json.

integration_point.description: An external system, service, or actor the system integrates with at its boundary.

protocol.description: e.g. REST/HTTPS, gRPC, message queue, file transfer.

trust_boundary.description: True when this integration crosses a trust/security boundary.

tech_decision.description: A locked technology decision with its rationale. Mirrors a tech-stack.md entry; significant decisions are also captured as ADRs.

component.description: e.g. language, framework, database, ORM, message bus.

adr_ref.description: ADR capturing this decision when it is architecturally significant.

system_nfr.description: A system-level non-functional requirement. Sourced from the PM plan NFRs and refined with quantified system targets.

schema_version.description: System-architecture-output contract version. Const 1.0 for this schema file.

created.description: ISO 8601 date the System Architecture Document was generated.

source_pm_plan.description: Relative path to the consumed PM plan requirements file (devforgeai/specs/requirements/{project}-requirements.md). REQUIRED: this field forces the skill to read the persisted PM plan from disk rather than relying on conversation context - the structural fix for Gap B (PM->Architecture handoff non-enforcement).

pm_plan_validation.description: Proof that the source PM plan was validated against ideation-output.schema.json v1.0 before consumption. Closes Gap B: the skill MUST validate, not assume.

source_brainstorm.description: Optional back-reference to the originating brainstorm (BRAINSTORM-NNN), propagated from the PM plan for provenance.

system_boundary.description: Definition of what is inside the system vs. outside it - the scope of what this architecture governs.

integration_topology.description: External systems, services, and actors the system integrates with at its boundary.

tech_stack_rationale.description: Locked technology decisions with rationale. The basis for tech-stack.md and the architecturally significant ADRs.

system_nfrs.description: System-level non-functional requirements with quantified targets.

deployment_architecture.description: How the system is deployed: environments, runtime topology, hosting model, CI/CD posture. Optional at inception but recommended.

adr_refs.description: Architecture Decision Records created or referenced by this System Architecture Document.

context_files_generated.description: Relative paths of the constitutional context files this skill produced (the 6 .md files, their .ai.md companions, and test-plan.ai.yaml). These remain immutable per the configuration-layer-mutability rule.

handoff.description: REQUIRED. The explicit handoff payload the downstream spec-driven-solution-architecture skill consumes.

recommended_approach.description: The strategic system-design direction the solution architect must work within.

critical_constraints.description: System-level constraints the solution architecture must not violate.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions escalated to the solution-architecture phase.
